why: Downward camera clearly shows the stuffed penguin on its table, already close to centered in frame (slightly ahead, slightly left). This is the final decision -- a 0.65m forward move plus a 34 deg turn risks knocking it off-center right as the flight ends. Taking only a small final nudge (forward+left) and holding heading to tighten centering rather than take a large move at the moment holding position matters most.
